<!-- Ascend Air messaging chat (ESA_Web_Deployment) -->
<script type="text/javascript">
function initEmbeddedMessaging() {
    if (!document.body) {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initEmbeddedMessaging);
        return;
    }
    try {
        embeddedservice_bootstrap.settings.language = 'en_US';
        embeddedservice_bootstrap.settings.targetElement = document.body;
        embeddedservice_bootstrap.init(
            '00Dg500000Mw8Oj',
            'ESA_Web_Deployment',
            'https://agentforceworkshopcom2-dev-ed.develop.my.site.com/ESWESAWebDeployment1724800920657',
            { scrt2URL: 'https://agentforceworkshopcom2-dev-ed.develop.my.salesforce-scrt.com' }
        );
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading Embedded Messaging: ', err);
    }
}
</script>
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://agentforceworkshopcom2-dev-ed.develop.my.site.com/ESWESAWebDeployment1724800920657/assets/js/bootstrap.min.js" onload="initEmbeddedMessaging()"></script>
